J&J's average quarterly gross profit in fiscal 2024 was about $15.34 billion.

I calculated it from the FY2024 10-K figures:
- Sales to customers were $88,821 million.
- Cost of products sold was $27,471 million.
- Annual gross profit was therefore $61,350 million.
- Dividing by four quarters gives about $15,337.5 million per quarter.

The 10-K doesn't report gross profit as a line item. I derived it as sales minus cost of products sold.
